fields.Name: T304 - Message Logs Filter And Search
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke hand-rolled <table> with client-side applyFilter (Status exact-match chips + multi-field substring search across provider/type/status/error) — a different code path from the generic ag-grid filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Message Logs section. Open the Filter control (funnel icon) and apply a Status filter such as 'Failed' (or 'Sent'/'Pending'), and/or type a term in the 'Search messages, providers, recipients...' box. Success = the log table RESPONDS — rows narrow to matches OR a clear 'No logs found' empty state appears. Then clear the filter/search and confirm the fuller list returns. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Applying a Status filter and/or a search term changes the log table (rows narrow OR a no-results empty state appears)
Clearing the filter and search restores the fuller list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
